changelog.headline: Deep weather + prop/usage battery (the thorough pass)
changes: VALIDATED wind→passing (r=-.167, -49 pass yds/gm at 15+mph) → pass/rec prop weather adjustment live
VALIDATED cold→passing (r=+.157) and market-trust ranking (rec_yds .81 > pass_yds .37)
VALIDATED red-zone targets→rec TDs (r=.82) as a TD-prop signal
RULED OUT wind→FG% (p=.38 — kickers adjust) and aDOT→variance (p=.08)
learned: weather's edge is on PASS PROPS not game totals; pass_yds is the least-projectable market

prop_picks.name: Rashid Shaheed
prop_picks.reason: We're higher on Rashid Shaheed than the board — 3.1 against a 2.5 that looks a step behind his role. We'll take the over before it catches up. Strip the 6% juice and the fair over is 44%; we make it 55%. That's +19 cents on the dollar at +113. Locked-in role, and this is the exact tier our numbers grade out sharp.
